free_tier.stated: Free: 2 TB. Community (join their Telegram channel): storage becomes 'Unlimited, while you are in the channel'. Both have no per-file size limit.

egress.terms: No egress fee on any plan: 'Browsing, streaming, sharing and downloading never cost credits on any plan.' No bandwidth meter is documented.

tooling: No public API on free/Community ('API: No' in the plan table); API access starts at Pro $9. Bulk paths on free are torrent import and URL/cloud-drive import, both credit-metered.
chaining: Unlimited storage behind a single free action (join a Telegram channel) is the cleanest free-tier gate found in this slot. Chain = 1 account with unlimited storage, but only 200 GB of new uploads per month on Community, so accumulation is slow rather than blocked.
limits_note: Free 2 TB / 200 GB monthly uploads (Community) / 1 upload at a time / 500 files per torrent. Credits: 50 on signup, +200 once for linking Telegram; torrent add 2, cloud import 1, zip extract 2, copy 10. Storage is re-checked — leaving the channel drops you to 2 TB and blocks new uploads above it, without deleting anything.
reliability_note: The unlimited tier is revocable by leaving a Telegram channel, and the real throttle is 200 GB/month of new bytes, so a 20 TiB cold archive would take ~8 years to fill. Signup is gated: createAcc returns 400 'Verification required. Please verify your identity first.'
